Nami|sup.identity: Aggressive enchanter. Surging Tides (passive) gives a brief speed boost to allies hit by her abilities. Aqua Prison (Q) throws a bubble that stuns every enemy on impact, Ebb and Flow (W) bounces between allies and enemies (healing one, damaging the other), Tidecaller's Blessing (E) empowers an ally: their attacks and abilities deal extra magic damage and slow, and Tidal Wave (R) sends a wave that knocks up, slows and damages every enemy hit.
Nami|sup.playstyle: Aggressive lane enchanter: she wins trades with W and E, and creates kills with her bubble. No clearly unfavorable matchups: her worst ones (Blitzcrank, Thresh, Braum) stay close to even. She crushes melee supports and slow mages (Swain, Camille, Pantheon, Xerath).
Nami|sup.early_game: Trade with Ebb and Flow (W): cast on your opponent, it bounces to your ADC (heal), then back; cast on your ADC, it then damages your opponent. Give Tidecaller's Blessing (E) to your ADC right before they attack. Keep Aqua Prison (Q) for an engage or to stop a dash.
Nami|sup.level_1: Ebb and Flow (W) first. After that, max W first, then E.
Nami|sup.level_2: Tidecaller's Blessing (E). E on your ADC, then W: a very strong trade at level 2.
Nami|sup.level_3: Aqua Prison (Q). A slow but powerful bubble: aim where your opponent is going, or under an enemy who's dashing.
Nami|sup.level_6: Tidal Wave: a wave that knocks up and slows. Engage on both opponents, or stop an enemy engage. It also speeds up the allies it touches.
power_spikes: First completed item: stronger heals and poke.
Nami|sup.lane_plan: Trade aggressively with W and E, look for the bubble when your opponent is slowed or immobile. Stay in the bot lane until level 5: since patch 26.16, your minion gold and XP are cut by a third elsewhere. The support role quest then makes your Control Wards cheaper (40 gold, two stored).
Nami|sup.trading: Basic trade: E on your ADC, then W. All-in: Q, E, W, R. Defense: Q under the enemy dash, R against an engage. Against Thresh or Blitzcrank, stay behind minions: a hook on you costs you the lane.
threats: Blitzcrank, Thresh and Braum: your worst matchups, close to even.
Hooks that catch you: you're fragile.
A missed bubble: your best defensive tool is then on cooldown.
mistakes: Throwing the bubble straight at the target instead of leading their movement.
Holding E instead of using it in every trade.
Standing in the open against a hook.

matchup_notes.Lulu: Poke trades: your W heals and damages at the same time.
matchup_notes.Thresh: Q under him when he steps up with his hook.
matchup_notes.Seraphine: She pokes too: win trades with E + W.
matchup_notes.Nautilus: Bubble him when he arrives with his anchor.
matchup_notes.Swain: He has to get close: poke him with W.

Nami|sup.mid_game: Stick with your ADC, place Control Wards and look for bubbles on isolated enemies.
Nami|sup.late_game: Stay behind your frontline: E on your best carry, W to heal, Q on the diver, R to engage or disengage.
Nami|sup.ahead: Harass harder and look for engages with Q and R.
Nami|sup.behind: Heal and protect: your bubble and ultimate stop divers.
Nami|sup.win_condition: To win this game, you want to win the lane through trades and create your team's engages with your bubble and wave.
Nami|sup.final_tip: Your bubble is slow: throw it where your opponent is going, or at an enemy who can't move (slowed, dashing, channeling).
